# Database (cms-api)

<!-- module-flows:start (generated by .claude/bin/module-index; do not edit) -->

Flows: [`content-modeling`](../../flows/content-modeling/FLOW.md).

<!-- module-flows:end -->

## Purpose

The shared persistence plumbing of cms-api: the Prisma client for schema `public`, the connection and TLS settings every pool uses, the transaction runner ports both databases implement, and the boot check that warns when the API role can run DDL (D19).

## Techniques

Ports and adapters: use cases depend on `TransactionRunner` / `UnitOfWork` only; the Prisma runner (`CORE_TRANSACTION_RUNNER`) and the content runner (in content-engine) share `AfterCommitCallbacks`, which runs callbacks once after commit, in order, never after a rollback. Connection fields stay separate (never a URL), so a password needs no encoding. The production role check runs once without delaying boot and only warns, naming problems, never values.

## Technologies

Prisma 7 with `@prisma/adapter-pg`; `pg`.

## Entry points

`DatabaseModule` (`PrismaService`, `CORE_TRANSACTION_RUNNER`); `openPrisma` for CLIs and tests; the ports in `TransactionRunner.port.ts`.

## Where to change what

A new connection setting: `DatabaseConfig.rules.ts` (and the config schema). Transaction rules: `AfterCommitCallbacks.store.ts`, used by both runners. Only core adapters may use `prismaTxOf`; use cases never see Prisma types.
